method.inputs: Four canonical JTLs; Soak writer is compared only by row count and timestamp range, not added as a run.

variants.main: Only these seven exact labels: 01 Login, 02 Products, 03 Product detail, 04 Add cart, 05 Get cart, 06 Checkout, 07 My orders

method.errors: success=false; 401/403 with success=true is counted separately, not as an error.
method.duration: max(timeStamp + elapsed) - min(timeStamp), milliseconds; throughput=count*1000/duration. Start timestamps are not assumed to be sorted.
method.percentiles: Nearest rank: sorted elapsed[ceil(p * count) - 1]; elapsed, Latency and Connect are in milliseconds.
method.minutes: Half-open 60 s windows by sample start, with common origin at the first start of the entire run. The final window ends at max completion of the entire run; RPS uses the actual window width. Empty windows have null p95.
method.stress: Group by Stress stage N in threadName; RPS uses each group min start to max completion. Post-ramp selects starts at least 30 s after the first observed stage start in that variant; RPS uses selected samples min start to max completion.
method.spike: Phases are half-open by sample start relative to first start of the entire run; requests crossing a boundary belong to their start phase. RPS uses the specified phase width. Starts at or beyond 360 s are reported separately.
method.threads: Unique threadName counts distinct threads observed across the window, not concurrent VUs. allThreads min/max are sample snapshots across all thread groups, not exact continuous concurrency peaks.
method.html_comparison: Compare Total and each label to HTML using absolute numeric tolerance 0.000001; missing entries are differences. main versus Total has a different filter when samples are excluded. Percentile estimator, throughput denominator or other report configuration may differ; causes are not assumed without evidence.
